lines:
Responsibilities: Extracts logical requirements from a verified portable frozen snapshot, compares them with core-supplied local capability facts, and prepares a non-authoritative continuation plan and complete unresolved-binding inventory for explicit user/core review.
Owned ephemeral DTOs: BindingRequirementV1 names stable logical tier/tool/node/plugin/MCP/external-agent identifiers, compatible versions/hashes/features, requested scopes/modes, workspace-reference needs, and whether a local CredentialRef is required; UnresolvedBindingInventoryV1 distinguishes missing, disabled, incompatible, ambiguous, and credential-needed; ContinuationRebindPlanV1 maps requirements to selected local candidate IDs and records the source snapshot/branch/checkpoint hashes. Draft persistence, if desired, belongs to the core configuration repository and is never portable history.
Ports: BuildInventory(VerifiedPortableBranchHandleV1, LocalCapabilityFactsV1), ProposeCandidates, ValidatePlanShape, and ReadPlan expose facts only. Exact logical-ID matches may be suggested but never accepted automatically. No credential value crosses this module.
Authority and continuation: imported bindings, provider endpoints, credential references, permits, approval responses, and authority manifests are discarded. The trusted core Project/Configuration Coordinator validates local candidates; the Authority Engine compiles a fresh manifest and user-visible summary; after explicit acceptance, the Snapshot Freezer creates a new immutable child continuation snapshot preserving the logical graph and source checkpoint lineage. The Canonical Event Committer alone creates/advances that portable child branch.
Degradation/NFRs: unresolved requirements leave the import inspectable/searchable but block continuation; diagnostics preserve every original logical reference and unknown field. Results are deterministic for the same verified snapshot and local facts, bounded/cancellable, schema-versioned, and auditable without sensitive values.
Non-responsibilities: no capability enabling/installing, credential access, authority grant, approval reuse, workspace-root expansion, snapshot mutation, branch/head write, worker launch, or execution.

data.name: Local Capability Rebind Plan & Unresolved Inventory
data.technology: Rust pure planning service over portable requirement DTOs and core-supplied local capability facts
